reasons: Compiled the variant and ran the trigger: only testEqualGeneralPaths fails, at ShapeUtilitiesTests.java:236 (quadTo(11,22,33,44) vs quadTo(1,2,3,4)). A full defects4j test run on the variant also fails only the trigger, and the three ownership tests pass. (a) segmentsMatch's javadoc says equal segments have 'the same segment type and the same coordinates'. On the trigger it returns true for two SEG_QUADTO segments with different coordinates, because count stays 0. Each hop above it returns the wrong verdict only by propagation: hops 3 and 4 are one-line pass-throughs, and hops 1 and 2 meet their own javadoc given a correct callee. (b) Every hop's javadoc matches its code. The 'current segments ... are equal' wording of hops 3 and 4 is short, but their bodies only delegate, and the gold spells out what equal means. (c) Every passing one-line non-gold edit is a bypass. A hop-4 reimplementation or AND-augmentation makes the gold dead or overrides it. Making the facade use flattening iterators (flatness 1.0 or 0.0) passes the trigger, the ownership tests and the full suite. But it keeps curve segments from the gold, leaves the gold's defect in place, and changes path equality into approximate or polyline equality: probes show a quad equal to a line at 1.0, distinct quads equal at 1.0, and a quad equal to its degree-elevated cubic at 0.0. That contradicts the exact-value convention of the sibling overloads and SerialUtilities, so it is not a competing repair. The three declared compensating edits all still fail the trigger (re-run). (d) The hop names (matchesSegmentRun, outlinesMatch, itemStepsMatch, pathStepsMatch, segmentsMatch) are neutral, and no added line uses fault vocabulary. The lie ('copied into a list of its points, read from the last segment back to the first ... compared with a single call to equals()') describes an algorithm the code does not perform, and it names neither quadratic segments nor coordinate counts. (e) The gold is five calls below the facade, and the five hops sit in five different existing classes. The facade is the original null guards plus one delegating call; the winding check moved into hop 1. The facade javadoc gains exactly one procedural sentence. The gold javadoc does not say how many coordinates a quad carries. test.patch is empty and the trigger is an existing test. (f) SerialUtilities.readShape rebuilds SEG_QUADTO from four coordinates (gp.quadTo(args[0..3])), beside two for move/line and six for cubic. writeShape writes every segment's coordinates, and the passing XYAreaRendererTests::testSerialization round-trips a GeneralPath through equal. The sibling equal overloads compare every defining value.
